units: Targ. Esth. VI, 1; a. fr.—Part. act. נָקֵיט, pass. נְקִיט holding.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 8:15">Ib. VIII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shevuot 38b:24">Shebu. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ חפצא וכ׳</he> he held an object in his hand (on being sworn).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:7">Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה נקיט חמרא בהדיה</he> was carrying wine with him.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>סירכא דגברא נְקִיטָה</he> she holds fast (clings to) the habit of her (deceased) husband. Sanh. 5ᵃ <he>נְקִיטְנָא רשותא</he> I hold a license (to teach).

<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>נְקוֹט לך מיהא וכ׳</he> hold at least half of it in thy hand, i.e. admit as certain &c.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 90b:15">Snh. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>נְקוֹטוּ</he> (not <he>נקוטי</he>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 53a">Ḥull. 53ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נַקְטִינָן</he>, <he>נְקִיטִינָן</he> we hold a tradition.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 116b">Sabb. 116ᵇ</cite> top <he>נקיט שמא וכ׳</he> quoted in Levy Talm. Dict. (ed. <he>שקיל</he>) had the reputation that &c.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:16">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>נְקוֹט נפשך בקצירי</he> have thyself counted among the sick, i.e. have the report spread that thou art sick.
Ḥull. 87ᵃ נקוט לי זימנא וכ׳ keep time for me &c., i.e. allow me three days’ time.—Trnsf. to contract a habit.

senses.gloss: to cause to hold, to give, hand. Targ. II Esth. IV, 16.—
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 110a:5">Pes. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַקְּטָא ליה אימיה וכ׳</he> (not <he>מנקיט</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) his mother was ready to hand him two cups.
<cite ref="Pesachim 110a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מַנְקֵיט ליה וכ׳</he> (or <cite ref="M01629"><he>מְנַקֵּיט</he></cite>) his servant was ready to hand him &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 85b:6">B. Kam. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>לאַנְקוּטֵיה גוונא דבישריה</he> to make him regain the natural color of flesh; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:6">B. Bath. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>נַקֵּיט ליה שוקא</he> make him take the market, i.e. give him the monopoly of sale.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:5">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>וכ׳</he> (read <he>הות … מְנַקְּטָא</he>) <he>הוה קא מנקיט</he> she picked the straw out of his hair.

senses.gloss: to cause to contract a habit, train.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 118b">B. Kam. 118ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 88a:2">B. Bath. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>אַנְקְטִינְהוּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00620"><he>נִיגְרָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 21:37">Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 37</cite> <he>אַקְּטֵיה בגנבותיה</he> he carried it (on his shoulder) when he stole it.
<cite ref="Yevamot 42b:10">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>מִנְּקִיט ואזיל הלכתא וכ׳</he> received instruction from him while walking.
